about_the_game:
Experience gaming freedom like never before with XBPlay — effortlessly stream your console to your device and immerse yourself in your favorite titles anytime, anywhere.

Features:
- 1080p and 720p Stream Quality.
- Multiple Clarity Boost Algorithms.
- Simulated and Direct Mouse and Keyboard Support.
- Connected Controllers and Touch Input.
- Many Customizable Settings.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS 2.0
  • Processor: Intel and AMD
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel® HD Graphics 2000, NVIDIA® GeForce® series 8 and 8M, Quadro FX 4800, Quadro FX 5600, AMD Radeon™ R600, Mobility Radeon™ HD 4330, Mobility FirePro™ series, Radeon™ R5 M230 or higher graphics card with up-to-date drivers
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: MacOS 10.11 (El Capitan)
  • Processor: Both Apple M1 Silicon and Intel CPUs
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: integrated and Intel
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
